name: delivery-workflows
description: Explicit Codex workflow for verifying local changes and submitting them as a project-compliant PR or MR.

interface.shortDescription: Verify and submit project-compliant PRs or MRs
interface.longDescription: An explicit-only Codex workflow that validates the current diff, applies only clear small fixes, creates a project-compliant PR or MR, and performs a read-only post-creation review.
defaultPrompt: Use $submit-pr-mr only when explicitly requested to verify the current diff and submit it as a project-compliant PR or MR.
